title: Abra de Ilog-Puerto Galera road reopens after landslide

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Abra de Ilog–Puerto Galera Road in Sitio Lukutan, Barangay Udalo, Abra de Ilog town reopened on Friday, Sept. 25, following clearing operations, but motorists were urged to exercise extreme caution due to an unstable boulder perched above the roadway, according to the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).
